articles.title: 'Swedish Piddington' that BANNED migrants for 13 years: In 1988, Sjobo shocked Europe with a controversial referendum. Nearly 40 years later, many wish the ban they voted for was never lifted
articles.description: In 1987, Sweden adopted a new strategy to distribute refugees more evenly across the country, and asked Sjobo, then a town of around 15,400, to take in around 15 people.
articles.content:
In Sweden's latest election, voters in the small town of Sjobo gave the anti-migration Sweden Democrats party a far bigger share of their support than the country as a whole.
